name: CI
on: [push, pull_request]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  unit:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, custom-linux]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - uses: ./.github/actions/unit
        with:
          mode: strict
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - run: npm run build
  schema:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - run: npm run schema
  docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - run: npm run docs
  ci-lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install actionlint
        run: |
          curl -fsSLo "$RUNNER_TEMP/actionlint.tar.gz" https://github.com/rhysd/actionlint/releases/download/v1.7.12/actionlint_1.7.12_linux_amd64.tar.gz
          echo "8aca8db96f1b94770f1b0d72b6dddcb1ebb8123cb3712530b08cc387b349a3d8  $RUNNER_TEMP/actionlint.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
          tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/actionlint.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP" actionlint
      - name: Check workflows
        run: '"$RUNNER_TEMP/actionlint" -shellcheck= -pyflakes= -config-file .github/actionlint.yaml .github/workflows/ci.yml'

name: Unit checks
description: Execute the unit checks
inputs:
  mode:
    description: Check mode
    required: true
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - shell: bash
      env:
        CHECK_MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
      run: npm test

self-hosted-runner:
  labels:
    - custom-linux
